identityProvisioning.requiredOperatorAction: MINIMUM: (1) In Clerk staging Dashboard create four synthetic users with private metadata e2eTestUser=true: e2e-professional (Professional org), e2e-prosecution (Prosecution org), e2e-unauthorized (no membership), e2e-cross-org-b (different org). (2) Enroll MFA on those users; do not disable instance MFA. (3) From nyayagrid-wp05-clerk-e2e: set STAGING_E2E_BASE_URL=https://staging.nyayagrid.com and STAGING_AUTH_INTERACTIVE=1; run npm run staging:auth:setup in a headed browser; complete sign-in+MFA until /app; confirm playwright/.auth/staging-user.json exists and GET /api/v1/session returns provider=clerk. (4) Optionally repeat for staging-user-b.json as e2e-cross-org-b. (5) Re-run npm run staging:e2e:clerk. Do NOT set REQUIRE_CLERK_MFA=0 or disable MFA.
